# Hello there.

Welcome to my personal website.

Here is my [résumé](media_pics/Lourenco_Xavier_CV.pdf).

My name is Lourenço Xavier (pronounced Low-rén-sso Shaviér). I am a current candidate for a bachelor’s degree in **Mathematics** and **Economics** at [Pitzer College](https://www.pitzer.edu/). My main research interest area is Environmental Economics, more specifically, valuation of ecosystem services, efficiency of resource preservation methods and the study of behavioral and policy interventions that improve environmental outcomes.

My academic advisers are [Linus Yamane, Ph.D](https://www.pitzer.edu/linus-yamane), [Shriya Nagpal, Ph.D](https://www.pitzer.edu/shriya-nagpal) and [Laura Grant, Ph.D](https://www.cmc.edu/academic/faculty/profile/laura-grant).
